files.docs/returns.md:
# Returns policy
Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Opened electronics carry a 15% restocking fee. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of receiving the item.
files.docs/shipping.md:
# Shipping
Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and is free on orders over $50. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days and costs $15. We ship to the US, Canada and the EU. Orders placed before 2pm ET ship the same day.
files.docs/warranty.md:
# Warranty
All devices include a 2-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Water damage and accidental drops are not covered. Warranty claims require the order number and a photo of the defect.
files.docs/accounts.md:
# Accounts
Passwords must be at least 12 characters. Two-factor authentication can be enabled under Settings > Security. Accounts inactive for 24 months are deleted after an email warning.
